title: Function-level composition of explicit raw cohomology pullbacks
statement: For the raw pullback functions of lem-sbc-higher-image-raw-pullback-composition, the function for a composite arrow is the composition of the two pullback functions in contravariant order.

source.place: Tag 09Z1, canonical comparison maps; expansion of the five-factor formula

proof.text: Apply function extensionality. Name the single coefficients KC,KB,KA and the canonical coefficient maps vg and vf.

Apply the arbitrary-derived-coefficient triangle composition theorem to f.left,g.left,vg,vf. Rewrite the composite coefficient by the proved restricted-single coefficient composition identity. Unfold higherDirectImageRawOverPullback, normalize Over.comp_left and the named single coefficients, and obtain the pointwise equality.

proof_origin.document: Stacks Project, Tags 03CB and 09Z1; existing proved raw source and single/shift coherence calculations
proof_origin.place: D4: combine arbitrary-derived-coefficient triangle composition with fully proved restricted single-coefficient composition; function extensionality completes the original unchanged statement. One remaining general triangle-composition hole.
